# CreaVerse

> A Pakistan-first learning platform for students, teachers, and creators, organised into three groups: School-in-a-Box (AI Mentor, Academy, Classroom), Outreach (opportunities, contests, community) and Mind Garden (journal and memory game).

CreaVerse helps learners from Matric and FSc through university and competitive exams, with a focus on underprivileged regions of Pakistan. It is free and open source (MIT).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the three groups.
- [About](/about): Mission, motto, and the story behind CreaVerse.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about classes, teachers, privacy and the AI Mentor.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the team.

Signed-in areas (AI Mentor, Academy, Classroom, Outreach, Mind Garden) require a free account.
